data.description:
## Description

**What**: Register debug-everything phases B, F, G, K in epic af26-dd5a-df6d-4f81's forbidden-action registry. Extend the PreToolUse hook to read both `.sprint-active` and `.debug-active` markers; honor `DSO_DEBUG_ACTIVE=0` escape hatch.

**Why**: af26's HARD-GATE enforcement infrastructure protects sprint phases; debug phases need the same protection.

**Scope**:
- IN: Add phases B, F, G, K of debug-everything to af26's (skill, phase, forbidden-tool) enumeration table; extend af26's PreToolUse hook to read both `.sprint-active` and `.debug-active` markers; honor `DSO_DEBUG_ACTIVE=0` escape hatch alongside `DSO_SPRINT_ACTIVE=0`.
- OUT: af26's core enforcement mechanism (depends on af26 being closed).

**DESCOPE CLAUSE**: If af26-dd5a-df6d-4f81 is NOT closed at the time this story enters sprint execution, this story descopes to a follow-on story re-parented under this epic. Skip this story and proceed.

## Done Definitions

- When complete (and only if af26 is closed), debug-everything phases B, F, G, K appear in af26's forbidden-action registry
  ← Satisfies: "Debug-everything phases B, F, G, K enumerated in the forbidden-action registry"
- When complete, af26's PreToolUse hook reads both `.sprint-active` and `.debug-active` markers and honors both `DSO_SPRINT_ACTIVE=0` and `DSO_DEBUG_ACTIVE=0` escape hatches
  ← Satisfies: "PreToolUse hook reads both .sprint-active and .debug-active markers"
- Unit tests written and passing for the extended hook reading both markers
  ← Satisfies: "HARD-GATE registration"

## Considerations

- [Reliability] This story is blocked on af26 closing; descope path is explicit

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As an orchestrator, debug-everything phases B/F/G/K are enumerated in af26's forbidden-action registry so the PreToolUse hook can enforce session-state guards (descopes if af26 open)
